I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **ticket #4092**.

- **Where it came from:** Ilse posted it in #north-random yesterday (Oct 13, 11:55). Dana is a member of that channel. Ilse said IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room.
- **Tip I passed on:** Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.
- **Status:** I found no newer update on the ticket in any channel Dana can see, and I told her that.

Earlier, Dana told me in a private message that she guesses the ticket number will end up as OPS-5546 next year. She asked me to keep that to myself, so I left it out of the channel reply.
